business.title: What kind of business is this?
business.description: e.g. 'a café in Portland', 'a small pottery studio'.

tools.name: stock_status
tools.description: What is out and running low (out first), each with its count, reorder point, the quantity to order, the supplier and lead time, plus orders on the way and drafts waiting, with ids. Call it first when asked what's low or what to order.

tools.name: add_item
tools.description: Save a stock item: name, unit, how many are on hand now, the reorder point, the par level to order up to, supplier, their lead time in days, and the unit cost in dollars. An existing name is updated, never duplicated. Call it as soon as an item is mentioned, before you describe it.

unit.description: How it is counted, e.g. 'carton', 'bag (5 lb)', 'sleeve of 50'.

onHand.description: How many are on the shelf now (needed for a new item).

reorderPoint.description: Reorder when stock falls to this many or fewer.

par.description: Order back up to this many.

leadDays.description: The supplier's lead time in days; it applies to every item from them.

unitCost.description: Price per unit in dollars, e.g. 3.8.

tools.name: record_stock
tools.description: Record stock coming in or going out. Pass received (delivered) and used (sold, used or thrown out) exactly as the person said them; the store does the arithmetic, so never work out the new total yourself. Pass count only when they counted the shelf. Call it the moment they tell you.

received.description: How many came in, as the person said it. The store adds it.

used.description: How many were sold, used or thrown out, as the person said it. The store takes it off.

count.description: Only when they counted the shelf: the number counted.

tools.name: draft_orders
tools.description: Draft purchase orders, one per supplier, for every item at or below its reorder point that is not already on order; quantities fill each item back up to its par. Running it again updates the drafts, never duplicates them. The person checks and places them.

supplier.description: Only this supplier; leave out for all of them.

tools.name: update_order
tools.description: Change a purchase order: mark it sent when the person says they placed it, received when it arrived (its quantities go into stock), or cancelled; or set one item's quantity on a draft. Call it as soon as they tell you.

order.description: Order id ('po-2') or the supplier's name.

item.description: To change a draft: the item whose quantity to set.

qty.description: To change a draft: the new quantity (0 takes the item off).

tools.name: list_stock
tools.description: Every item with its count, reorder point, par, supplier, lead time and price, and every open order.

tools.name: page_add_item
tools.description: Add or update a stock item.

unit.description: How it is counted, e.g. 'carton', 'bag (5 lb)', 'sleeve of 50'.

onHand.description: How many are on the shelf now (needed for a new item).

reorderPoint.description: Reorder when stock falls to this many or fewer.

par.description: Order back up to this many.

leadDays.description: The supplier's lead time in days; it applies to every item from them.

unitCost.description: Price per unit in dollars, e.g. 3.8.

tools.name: page_record_stock
tools.description: Record stock received, used or counted.

received.description: How many came in, as the person said it. The store adds it.

used.description: How many were sold, used or thrown out, as the person said it. The store takes it off.

count.description: Only when they counted the shelf: the number counted.

tools.name: page_draft_orders
tools.description: Draft purchase orders for everything at or below its reorder point.

supplier.description: Only this supplier; leave out for all of them.

tools.name: page_update_order
tools.description: Mark an order sent, received or cancelled.

order.description: Order id ('po-2') or the supplier's name.

item.description: To change a draft: the item whose quantity to set.

qty.description: To change a draft: the new quantity (0 takes the item off).
